messages:
ash: Heads-up — saw a repro where a stream hits a soft-trim, client retries, and we end up with a provisional charge in Console that later becomes a confirmed charge as well -> customer effectively charged twice. Example logs below.

ash: log snippet:```
[2026-03-19T15:12:03Z] session=s-9b3 req=r-423 event=STREAM_TRIM code=SOFT_TRIM last_offset=1234
[2026-03-19T15:12:13Z] session=s-9b3 req=r-424 event=STREAM_OPEN attempt=2
[2026-03-19T15:12:14Z] session=s-9b3 req=r-424 event=TOOLCALL_FLUSH toolcall_id=tc-77 tokens=78
[2026-03-19T15:12:15Z] billing: provisional_charge session=s-9b3 attempt=1 tokens=150
[2026-03-19T15:12:16Z] billing: confirmed_charge session=s-9b3 attempt=2 tokens=78
```

kevin: can you attach the full request ids? is this always with a toolcall flush, or also plain streaming responses?

ash: full IDs in the repro bundle I'll attach to the ticket. This one had a mid-stream function call (so flush path). observed in us-west hosted. client retried after ~10s.

maria: quick clarification: by "soft-trim" do you mean we evicted KV & returned SOFT_TRIM to client (so client restarts from scratch) vs an EOF from client?

ash: server returned SOFT_TRIM. client re-opened stream without resume token. Console showed provisional tokens from first attempt then after the toolcall flush we got confirmed tokens that overlapped.

olivia: sounds like provisional ledger records the pre-trim tokens and the flush path writes a separate confirmed ledger entry — overlap not deduped. we need a rule to avoid double-confirming the same offset range.

sre-jen: implementation idea: assign each stream attempt a monotonic attempt number and store offset ranges as (session_id, attempt, [start,end]). When confirming, only mark offsets that haven't been confirmed by a previous confirmed entry. basically canonicalize by earliest non-overlapping prefix.

kevin: UX: Console currently shows provisional in orange then flips to final. Customers get confused. Could we show a tooltip "pending confirmation — may be suppressed on retry" and expose the attempt id in the panel?

billing-bot: [billing event] provisional_charge: customer=cust_123 amount=0.023 tokens=150 session=s-9b3 attempt=1

ash: additional note: the duplication only occurs when client restarts from scratch after soft-trim. resume-token path didn't double-charge in my tests.

maria: could model-specific KV eviction heuristics make this worse (rebuilt context causing toolcall payload to be different)? worth checking.

olivia: telemetry ask: add these tags to billing/stream events: session_id, attempt, last_offset, truncated_flag, toolcall_id, origin_ip. that will let us correlate provisional -> confirmed. also add a metric for "provisional suppression" so we can alert if it spikes.

kevin: dashboard change: in per-route billing panel add an expandable section: "Recent provisional events" showing attempt and offset ranges + link to raw logs. helps CS triage.

ash: small repro code included in ticket: client retries with same session id. server returns SOFT_TRIM and new attempt increments but client doesn't clear provisional marker.

sre-jen: short-term mitigation: when confirming, check for existing provisional entries that overlap and suppress confirmation for the overlapping portion if the new confirmed write's offsets intersect and the confirmed write happened within a grace window (e.g., 60s). emit an audit event when we suppress so CS can see it.

kevin: that works as a quick fix. long-term we should do ledger-level dedupe: canonical attribution by (session_id, offset-range) independent of attempt. That is cleaner but requires a small ledger schema migration.

maria: internal API debate: change provisional semantics to be idempotent (provisional carries a unique provisional-id globally) vs require clients to request new session ids on full restart. Both break some client assumptions. which is less risky?

olivia: idempotent provisional-id seems backwards compatible server-side but we need clients to stop reusing session ids in some cases. tough call.

ash: I'll open an RFC with repro logs, proposed ledger patch, and a canary plan. short-term patch: suppression + telemetry + console microcopy change.

kevin: can we also flag affected customers in the Console with a small banner until fixed? CS will want that.

olivia: i'll own the dashboard + console microcopy. eng-runtime — can you own telemetry + server patch?

ash: i can take the server patch initial PR. will include unit tests for overlapping offset dedupe.

kevin: add a canary rollout label so we can watch billing delta. also add an alert for any >0.5% increase in provisional suppression events during rollout. :thumbsup:

sre-jen: noted. i'll add an ops runbook entry for investigating suppressed confirmations (query sample by session).

ash: thanks — opening RFC + ticket now, will ping this thread when PR lands. :raised_hands:
